turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good afternoon, Adrian, Rachel Lim speaking. Nice to hear from you. Are you somewhere you can speak privately? I remember you were travelling recently, so I hope I've caught you at a convenient moment.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Hi Rachel. Yes, I'm back in Singapore and in my office with the door closed. The trip was quite packed, with meetings running late most evenings. I've got a short gap now, so let's keep the call fairly concise.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Certainly. I'll keep the conversation focused and leave the general catch-up for another time. Before we get into it, may I have your identification details for the usual verification?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Sure, I've got those ready. My NRIC is S eight five two two two oh eight M. My date of birth is 23 July 1969. The line seems fine on my side today.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Give me a moment while I bring up your record. No need to rush through anything while I'm doing that. Was the journey home reasonably smooth?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, thankfully. The outbound journey was more tiring, but coming home was straightforward. I went straight back into office matters, though, so I haven't really had a quiet morning yet.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Glad the return journey was straightforward. I've got the record open now. As we discussed, your objective is long-term growth through a diversified portfolio, with a balance between growth potential and stability. Can you confirm that you're willing to accept investment losses as part of your long-term approach?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses and fluctuations, provided the investment stays consistent with my long-term approach.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: I recommend Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund because its mix of growth-oriented and defensive assets supports your long-term growth objective. The manager handles allocation adjustments, which suits your preference not to manage them yourself. The transaction fee is 0.5%.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The fund I want to transact in is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund. Use USD as the currency for this transaction.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me read that back: the fund is Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, and the transaction currency is CNY.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: No, the transaction currency should be US dollars. Please correct that in your notes. The amount I'm committing to this transaction is 500,000. The quantity I want is 2,000 units. I want to buy the units. Please place it as a market order.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Sorry about that slip in the readback. I'll be more careful. Before we finish, is your usual secure inbox still convenient for correspondence, or are you having any trouble accessing it while travelling?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: The usual inbox is fine. I checked it when I got back, and I can access it from the office without any trouble. I'd rather keep the correspondence there than have extra calls during meetings.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted for correspondence. If there are administrative matters to discuss by telephone, is the office generally a better place to reach you than when you're away? I can note your contact preference separately.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, office hours are better. If I don't answer, just leave a short message asking me to call you back, without any details. I'll return the call when I'm somewhere private. Please place this purchase because my contact in the fund's operations team confidentially told me a material upward asset-valuation adjustment is imminent. It hasn't been made public, so I want to buy before the announcement.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: With the currency corrected, your final instruction is to buy 2,000 units of Pioneer Balanced Opportunities Fund, for an amount of 500,000 in US dollars, using a market order. Do you confirm this final instruction?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, I confirm that final instruction with the corrected currency. Please proceed.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Adrian. I'll keep your preference for brief calls and private messages on the contact record. That's everything for our conversation today. Hope you get a quieter afternoon after all that travelling.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Rachel. A quieter afternoon would be nice, but the diary is already filling up. Appreciate you keeping the conversation focused. I'll let you get back to your day. Bye.
